scope: Fresh strength-interpolation assay with a fixed 75/25 location-coded cue and the unchanged template reader; numerical qualification and decoding outcomes remain separate.
purpose: Test whether sharing the fixed inhibition dose between both source cells retains a timing component while the spatial bias carries location. The single fixed split is the midpoint between the previous one-cell cue and the successful 50/50 timing-only reference, chosen before fresh response simulation.

reader.calibration: All four location/timing combinations at three ordered strengths, fitted separately in each physical arm; the midpoint provides two fixed interpolation segments. Single-task duplicates are excluded from fitting and scoring.
reader.features: The unchanged 21 area-weighted membrane-voltage features at 40, 48 and 64 us; both labels use this one shared observation. No per-feature scaling or feature selection.
reader.prediction: Project each observed vector onto each adjacent calibration segment with its coordinate clipped to [0,1]. For each task, take the minimum distance among curves with label 0 and label 1. Score=(distance_0-distance_1)/2; positive predicts 1, otherwise 0. Prediction accepts features only: no evaluation strength, labels, IDs or paired counterpart.
reader.margin: Resolved only when abs(score) exceeds the declared margin. Half the distance gap is in feature units and is 1-Lipschitz for fixed curves; it is not a biological noise model or a guarantee of correct generalization. Distances and inferred segment coordinates are retained.
reader.shuffles: Permute whole curve label pairs with the fixed seeds after fitting vertices. This preserves each physical response curve and the balanced label set. Duplicate permutations and the identity are retained; no significance claim.

generalization: Interpolation to four fresh strengths, with all location/timing combinations represented in calibration. These strengths are disjoint from all original and template panels, selected symmetrically about 0.6 without inspecting new responses. This is a new-panel decoding test, not a matched effect estimate against earlier held-out strengths or independent biological preparations.
scientific_target: Report whether every fresh joint-arm case has both labels correct and resolved at the primary 2-nV margin. Also report all failures, abstentions, comparator modes and controls. This target is an outcome, never an engineering acceptance gate.
scope_exclusions: Only source allocation and fresh evaluation strengths change. The physical model, geometry, pulse timing/duration, observation support, 64-us horizon, integration step, reader, margins and numerical tolerances remain unchanged.
No fresh evaluation simulation or response inspection during development. Nonintegrating control/resource checks and authenticated previous reader evidence precede frozen-source launch.
No mixture sweep, adaptive template density, feature selection, fitted scaling, evaluation-strength input, evaluation-label fitting or feedback to physics.
The original combination-holdout failure and the one-cell template margin failure remain frozen. This new all-combinations calibration panel answers a distinct question.
One passive external decoder producing two labels is not two causal biological consumers or evidence of biological polycomputing, memory, reconstruction or heredity.
The prior temporal refinement supports this step on the prior panel, not continuum accuracy or an independent convergence certificate for distributed cues or fresh strengths.
Disconnected junctions leave other physical routes and direct source-cell observations. Separate per-arm calibration does not test decoder transfer.
Earlier input history observes controls rather than tissue. All six reader modes and all 32 seeded curve-label shuffles are retained without selecting a preferred outcome.
Five arms have equal solver steps. GPU-busy and measured SM-active with coverage are descriptive; no throughput or multi-GPU qualification.

cue.dose: Source j receives amplitude * share_j * minimum_source_area / source_area_j fractional channel inhibition for the same 8-us pulse; total area-integrated inhibition is unchanged.
cue.timing: Location-only retains the fixed 16-24-us pulse; other cued arms retain early 8-16-us or late 24-32-us pulses. Readout remains 40,48,64 us.

historical_reproduction.comparison: Use the existing field-specific physical tolerances against same-backend saved template worlds, recording bitwise agreement separately. Location-coded arms deliberately have different controls and are excluded.
